dedupe_keys.name: woah wahis world animal health information system

description: The official global system for reporting animal disease outbreaks. A ReliefWeb copy of the OIE press release of 18 March 2021 says the organisation, which has collected, verified and published official animal health information since 1924, launched the new OIE-WAHIS platform for animal disease and veterinary capacity reporting, with prompt dissemination of outbreak information, geographic localisation of outbreaks to target trade restrictions, and open access to data. The platform is free to use online. Coverage is WOAH member countries worldwide. Caveats: reports depend on national notification, and the WAHIS site itself rendered no readable text from the cloud, so field lists and download formats are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives dated, located outbreaks of diseases such as avian influenza or African swine fever that disrupt livestock supply chains and trade. A related catalogue record is the FAO GIEWS agricultural stress index system.
